Job description

Description:


Position Summary

Designs and develops software solutions and business intelligence applications for Avum's government programs. Provides technical leadership, mentoring, and serves as the technical point of contact for cross-functional and external partners.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop software solutions including ETL applications, Java services, and data pipelines
  • Maintain data sources for BI reporting (Oracle, MarkLogic, QuickSight, Tableau)
  • Serve as technical lead for the engineering team and review designs and code

Requirements

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience with Java and SQL
  • Experience with AWS and data pipelines
